40012404.author: पदार्थः
40012404.content: राजा king, शत्रुरावणः tormentor of enemies, रावणः Ravana, मैथिलीम् Mythili, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः thereafter, सर्वाः all, राक्षसीः demonesses, सन्दिश्य च having commanded, निर्जगाम departed.

40012404.author: Translation
40012404.content: King Ravana, tormentor of enemies, having thus spoken to Mythili commanded the demonesses and departed.

40012405.author: पदार्थः
40012405.content: राक्षसेन्द्रे the lord of demons, निष्क्रान्ते having left, पुनः again, अन्तःपुरम् to the inner chambers, गते gone, भीमरूपाः women of hideous appearance, ताः those, राक्षस्य: demonesses, सीताम् Sita, समभिदुद्रुवुः ran to her.

40012405.author: Translation
40012405.content: As the demon king left for his abode all the demonesses of hideous looks rushed towards Sita and crowded around her.

40012406.author: पदार्थः
40012406.content: ततः then, राक्षस्यः demonesses, सीताम् to Sita, उपागम्य went near, क्रोधमूर्छिताः  senses lost in anger, परम् very, परुषया harsh, वाचा words, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, इदम् thus, अब्रुवन् spoke.

40012406.author: Translation
40012406.content: The demonesses, overcome with anger, approached Sita and harshly said:

40012407.author: पदार्थः
40012407.content: सीते O Sita, पौलस्त्यस्य in Paulastya's, वरिष्ठस्य the distinguished, महात्मनः of the highsouled, दशग्रीवस्य tennecked, रावणस्य Ravana's, भार्यात्वम् to be his wife, न बहुमन्यसे not treating it as a privilege

40012407.author: Translation
40012407.content: 'O Sita don't you think it is a privilege to be the  wife of the highsouled, tennecked Ravana, who is the distinguished king of a high family of sage Paulastya?

40012408.author: पदार्थः
40012408.content: ततः then, एकजटा नाम called Ekajata, राक्षसी shedemon, क्रोधाताम्राक्षी eyes red with anger, करतलोदरीम् with a belly of the size of the palm, सीताम् Sita, आमन्त्य्र having called, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40012408.author: Translation
40012408.content: Then Ekajata, a shedemon of hideous looks, eyes red with anger and a belly of the size of the palm said to Sita:

40012409.author: पदार्थः
40012409.content: षण्णाम् of the six, प्रजापतीनाम् of Prajapatis, यः he who was, चतुर्थः fourth, प्रजापतिः, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, मानसः born out of mind, पुत्रः a son, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विश्रुतः very famous.

40012409.author: Translation
40012409.content: 'The mindborn son of Brahma is well known as Paulastya. He was the fourth  among the six Prajapatis (Maricha, Atri, Angira, Pulastya, Plaha, Kratu).

40012410.author: पदार्थः
40012410.content: नाम्ना with the name, विश्रवा नाम Vishravas by name, प्रजापतिसमप्रभः equal in splendour to Prajapati, तेजस्वी glorious, सः महर्षिः that sage, पुलस्त्यस्य Pulastya's, मानसः mindborn, सुतः son.

40012410.author: Translation
40012410.content: 'This glorious mindborn sage Pulastya's son is the famous Vishrava who, in glory and splendour was equal to Prajapatis.

40012411.author: पदार्थः
40012411.content: विशालाक्षि a largeeyed lady, शत्रुरावण: a tormentor of enemies, रावणः Ravana, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, त्वम् you, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य lord of demons, तस्य his, भार्या wife, भवितुम् to become, अर्हसि you deserve, चारुसर्वाङ्गि a lady of beautiful limbs, मया by me, उक्तम् spoken, वाक्यम् words, किम् why, नानुमन्यसे  not heeding.

40012411.author: Translation
40012411.content: 'O largeeyes lady to become the wife of the lord of demons is a stroke of good luck. You deserve to be one. O lady of beautiful limbs why don't you accept his proposal?'

40012412.author: पदार्थः
40012412.content: ततः then, मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा cateyed, हरिजटा नाम called Harijata, राक्षसी ogress, कोपात् with anger, नयने both eyes, विवर्त्य rolling, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40012412.author: Translation
40012412.content: Then an ogress called Harijata said this in anger, her cateyes rolling:

40012413.author: पदार्थः
40012413.content: येन by him, त्रयस्त्रिंशत् thirtythree, देवाः gods, देवराजश्च Indra, king of the gods, निर्जिताः are conquered, तस्य his, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of ogres, त्वम् you, भार्या wife, भवितुम् to become, अर्हसि you ought to be.

40012413.author: Translation
40012413.content: 'You ought to be the wife of the lord of ogres who has vanquished thirty three crores of gods including Indra, their king.'

40012414.author: पदार्थः
40012414.content: ततः then, प्रघसा नाम named Praghasa, राक्षसी ogress, क्रोधमूर्छिता overwhelmed with anger, तदा then, भर्त्सयन्ती deriding, घोरम् terrific manner, इदम् these, वचनं तु words also, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40012414.author: Translation
40012414.content: Then an ogress named Praghasa, overwhelmed with anger, deriding Sita said these terrible words:

40012415.author: पदार्थः
40012415.content: वीर्योत्सिक्तस्य Valiant, शूरस्य hero's, सङ्ग्रामेषु in wars, अनिवर्तिनः hero who never retreats, बलिनः powerful, वीर्ययुक्तस्य mighty one, भार्यात्वम् to be a wife, किम् why, न लप्स्यसे not wishing.

40012415.author: Translation
40012415.content: 'Why don't you wish to be the wife of such a mighty and powerful king, a valiant hero who has never beaten a retreat in war?

40012416.author: पदार्थः
40012416.content: राजा king, महाबलः mighty, रावणःRavana, प्रियाम् his dear, बहुमताम् favourrite lady, सर्वासाम् of all, महाभागाम् highly respectable, भार्याम् wife, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, त्वाम् you, उपैष्यति he is desirous

40012416.author: Translation
40012416.content: 'Even renouncing his highly respectable,  favourite wife among all, mighty Ravana is prepared to accept you.

40012417.author: पदार्थः
40012417.content: रावणः Ravana, स्त्रीसहस्रेण with a thousand wives, समृद्धम् rich, नानारत्नोपशोभितम् decorated with many gems, अन्तःपुरम् inner chambers, समुत्सृज्य abandoning, त्वाम् you, उपैष्यति is desiring.

40012417.author: Translation
40012417.content: 'Ravana is prepared to abandon a thousand wives in his prosperous harem  decorated with all kinds of gems in order to accept you.'

40012418.author: पदार्थः
40012418.content: विकटा नाम called Vikata, अन्या other, राक्षसी तु ogress also, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, येन by whom, असकृत् often, युद्धे in war, देवताः gods, समरे in war, नागगन्धर्वदानवाः nagas, gandharvas and demons, निर्जिताः vanquished, सः he, ते your, पार्श्वम् side, आगतः has come to you.

40012418.author: Translation
40012418.content: Another ogress called Vikata said, ' Know that he who has often defeated gods in war and has vanquished nagas, gandharvas and demons has come to you (seeking your favour)'.

40012419.author: पदार्थः
40012419.content: विकटा नाम called Vikata, अन्या other, राक्षसी तु ogress also, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, येन by whom, असकृत् often, युद्धे in war, देवताः gods, समरे in war, नागगन्धर्वदानवाः nagas, gandharvas and demons, निर्जिताः vanquished, सः he, ते your, पार्श्वम् side, आगतः has come to you.

40012419.author: Translation
40012419.content: Another ogress called Vikata said, ' Know that he who has often defeated gods in war and has vanquished nagas, gandharvas and demons has come to you (seeking your favour)'.

40012420.author: पदार्थः
40012420.content: अधमे O foolish woman, सर्वसमृद्धस्य who has abundance of wealth, महात्मनः great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of ogres, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, भार्यात्वम् to be wife, अद्य now, किम् why, नेच्छसे do not you desire

40012420.author: Translation
40012420.content: 'O foolish woman why don't you seek the wifehood of a glorious king of demons who has abundance of wealth?'

40012421.author: पदार्थः
40012421.content: ततः then, दुर्मुखी नाम named Durmukhi, राक्षसी ogress, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, आयतापाङ्गे lady of long side glaces, यस्य whose, भीतः by fear of whom, सूर्यः Sun, न तपति not scorch, यस्य by whose, भीतः by fear of whom, मारुतः wind, न वाति स्म not blow, तस्य his, त्वम् you, किम् why, न तिष्ठसि not yield

40012421.author: Translation
40012421.content: Then an ogress called Durmukhi said, 'O lady of long sideglances why don't you yield to him, afraid of whom the Sun scorches not and strong winds blow not?

40012422.author: पदार्थः
40012422.content: सुभ्रु lady with beautiful eyebrows, भामिनि radiant one, यस्य whose, भयात् fear, तरवः trees, पुष्पवृष्टिम् rain of flowers, मुमुचुः released, यदा whenever, इच्छति wishes, शैलाश्च even mountains, जलदाश्च clouds also, पानीयम् water, नैरृतराजस्य for the king of the southwest, Ravana, राजराजस्य king of kings, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, भार्यार्थे to become his wife, बुद्धिम् mind accepting, त्वम् you, किम् why, न कुरुषे not wishing?

40012422.author: Translation
40012422.content: 'O lady of beautiful brows why don't you make up your mind to accept the king of kings, afraid of whom the trees rain flowers, the mountains and clouds release water at his will? Ravana is the king of the southwest, direction Why don't you wish to be his wife?
